method: Every non-reprint card from Lorwyn Eclipsed through Reality Fracture (and their Commander decks) was checked against the 20 most recently updated Bracket 2-3 Stella Lee decks on Moxfield and EDHREC's Stella Lee pages, then filtered for casting two or three spells a turn and copying them. Game Changers excluded.
summary: Stella rewards casting two or three spells a turn. The new cards are mostly cost reducers and spells that count twice (rebound, flashback). The badge on each card counts the sources that include it; "Claude's pick" means no list runs it yet.

sets.name: EDHREC Recommendations
sets.note: Cards Stella Lee players commonly run in Bracket 2 and 3 that aren't in your deck, from EDHREC's bracket pages and average decks.
